name: Angus mac Angus
text: Angus mac Angus, written also as Óengus mac Óengusa, was an Irish poet of the tenth century. The annals give his death in the year 932. They set him above the other poets of the land.

attributes.attribute: tenth-century Irish poet, chief poet of Ireland

okr.objective: State the poet Angus mac Angus.
key_results: Date his death to the year 932.
Name him as chief poet of Ireland.
